company.name: Natify
company.shortDescription: Natify is an AdTech company specializing in native in-game advertising solutions.
company.description: Natify is a UAE-based company that offers innovative and scalable native product placement solutions for games and metaverse environments. Non-intrusive approach to in-game advertising benefits both game owners and brands by maintaining the integrity of the game and improving the gaming experience for users. Natify's services include seamless native ad display, real-time tracking and billing, free implementation for game owners, targeted product placement based on geography, and data collection and reporting features for campaign optimization.

items.title: Natify, a new startup in the UAE that is taking in-game advertising in the metaverse to the next level. This startup will be interesting for digital investors.
